subject: Re: Nova Bank - Procurement & Onboarding Next Steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Chopra <aisha.chopra@novabank.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-25T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap & next steps (Vendor onboarding / PO)

Hi Aisha —

Thanks again for the time today — great conversation and appreciate the clarity on Nova Bank's high-level goals for LLM-powered customer support summarization. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

Key takeaways:
- Primary use case: summarization + routing for tier 1 support, pilot ~3 teams (English first)
- Success criteria: 50% reduction in manual triage time, <200ms median inference latency for 1k concurrent users
- Data controls: customer PII redaction + VPC/private deployment preferred for pilot

Action items / asks from Nova Bank:
1) Stakeholder list: economic buyer, legal, procurement, and security contacts (names + best emails) — will use for procurement/contract routing
2) Vendor onboarding: please confirm required forms (vendor form, W9, insurance) and PO process/timeline
3) Invoicing: billing contact and preferred invoice fields (PO#, billing email)
4) Security posture: any questionnaire or portal access so our security team can respond (we can attach SOC2 summary and initial answers)
5) Timeline: target PO date for pilot approval / any gating procurement cycles we should know about

Attached: Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf (blank) and Redwood_SOC2-summary.pdf — I can fill whatever you need and loop in our security lead Neha for the questionnaire.

Proposed next step: once you share stakeholders + procurement expectations, we’ll produce a short Mutual Action Plan (1 page) and target a PO by mid-May if that aligns.

Thanks — I’ll hold next week Thursday open for a quick alignment call if useful.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap — that matches what we discussed. Below are the internal stakeholders and procurement notes: 

Stakeholders:
- Economic buyer: Tom Reynolds, CFO <tom.reynolds@novabank.com> (final sign-off on contracts/PO)
- Procurement lead: Daniel Kim <daniel.kim@novabank.com> (manages vendor forms and PO issuance)
- Legal: Priya Natarajan (in-house counsel; I can intro)
- Security: Mei Chen, InfoSec (will own the questionnaire)
- Pilot owner / product: Aisha Chopra (me)

Procurement / onboarding process:
- Required items: completed vendor onboarding form, W9, proof of insurance if coverage >$100k (standard)
- Payment terms: Net 30 after invoice; PO is required before we can process invoices
- Typical timeline: Once we receive completed paperwork + pricing, procurement takes ~2 weeks to issue PO (can be longer if legal needs redlines)

For the security questionnaire: we use a portal (secureshare.novabank.com). I will create access for Redwood and ping Mei to confirm which sections are highest priority. In the meantime, the SOC2 summary you attached is helpful — please ask your security lead to fill the NovaBank_Security_Questionnaire (I attached an initial copy).

Action I’ll take this week:
- Introduce you to Daniel (procurement) and Priya (legal) — expect intros by EOD tomorrow
- Create portal access for your security contact (Neha), plus share document checklist
- Tentative PO target: aiming for May 20th approval for pilot (depends on legal review)

Thanks — looking forward to the MAP.

Best,
Aisha Chopra
Sr. Product Manager, Customer Experience
Nova Bank

Subject: Re: Post-call recap & next steps (Vendor onboarding / PO)

Hi Aisha —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the stakeholder list. I'll start the MAP draft and populate pricing and timeline items. A few clarifications from our side so procurement has everything they need: 

1) Invoicing / billing details
- Redwood standard: we invoice to billing@redwood-invoices.com with Net 30 terms. Can Nova Bank confirm the billing contact and whether PO number is required on the invoice line?
- Do you require an invoice to be sent to a P-card email (procure@novabank.com) or to the accounting team (ap@novabank.com)?

2) PO fields / vendor setup
- Do you need our DUNS or tax ID on the vendor form? Our tax ID is on the W9; happy to include DUNS if required.

3) Security / technical contacts
- Looping in Neha (our Head of Security & Trust) — Neha, Aisha mentioned a portal (secureshare.novabank.com). Can you confirm who at Nova we should add? Neha will complete the questionnaire and provide additional artifacts (encryption, network diagrams, SOC2 report) as allowed.

4) Timeline
- We’ll target the May 20 PO date you referenced. If legal needs redlines, we can provisionally start the pilot under a limited ingestion agreement (data controls + privacy addendum) while legal completes the contract — would that be acceptable?

If you want, I can put together a one-page MAP and a short pricing appendix and share by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
